name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.download.SpeechVoiceDownloadLandingWebviewActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an app-download ad selects a web landing page. It loads the promotion in an embedded browser and connects its download controls to the SDK.
disableEffect: The web-based app-download offer and its download action will no longer open.
